object: SOURCE-BOUND ONE-STEP FORCED-COLOR BASE CLOSURE ONLY

primary_predicates.R1: R1_P(u,c)=1 iff the final compiled source state P has an extension phi with phi(u)=c.
primary_predicates.R2: R2_P(u,v,c)=1 iff the nonedge baseline state P has an extension phi with phi(u)=phi(v)=c.

scope.state: P is a source-valid final state in the current authoritative lineage.
scope.single_force: u is in U=X union Y and c is in the exact admissible palette A(u).
scope.pair_force: u,v are in U=X union Y, uv is a nonedge, and c is in A(u) cap A(v).
scope.component_law: Every dynamic vertex participating in the gate is complete or anticomplete to every connected residual Y0 component, as supplied by the sealed current source lineage.
scope.base_only: The gate concerns preservation of the base seeded-precoloring structural layer and exact extension semantics after one forcing step. It does not assert return to the final hard class.

single_force_construction.residual: Y0'={y in Y0 : yu is not an edge}.
single_force_construction.component_form: By dynamic-to-component uniformity, Y0' is the union of exactly those old connected Y0 components anticomplete to u.

pair_force_construction.properness_guard: uv is a nonedge and c is admissible at both endpoints relative to the already fixed vertices.
pair_force_construction.component_form: Y0'' is a union of whole old connected Y0 components because both u and v are uniform on each old component.

proof_obligations.base_i_connected_seed: Each forced dynamic vertex already has a neighbor in the old seed under the current source partition/list contract; adding one or both vertices therefore preserves connectedness of the seed.
proof_obligations.base_ii_no_outside_complete_to_seed: Any vertex complete to the enlarged seed would also be complete to the old seed; the old prohibition is monotone under seed enlargement.
proof_obligations.base_iii_residual_canonicality: An old Y0 vertex remains anticomplete to the enlarged seed exactly when it is nonadjacent to every newly forced vertex. Old non-Y0 vertices already had an old-seed neighbor.
proof_obligations.component_integrity: No old residual component is cut: each forced dynamic vertex is complete or anticomplete to each old connected Y0 component.
proof_obligations.base_iv_no_mixing: Old non-Y0/non-X0 vertices inherit the old no-mixing law on retained residual edges. A vertex leaving Y0 lies in a removed old component and is anticomplete to every retained old component. The newly forced vertices are anticomplete to every retained component by definition.
proof_obligations.extension_equivalence_single: P has an extension with u=c iff the one-step reseeded base state has an extension; graph edges are unchanged and the only new fixed assignment is exactly u=c.
proof_obligations.extension_equivalence_pair: P has an extension with u=v=c iff the pair-reseeded base state has an extension; graph edges are unchanged and uv is a nonedge.
proof_obligations.R2_identity: R2_P(u,v,c)=1 iff P[u<-c] has an extension with v=c. Writing this as sequential R1 is a logical identity only; it is not yet an algorithmic recursion theorem.

ordered_checks: Verify the exact source definition needed for every u in U to have an old seed neighbor.
Do not inspect recursive depth or claim polynomiality in this gate.
Record which full-final invariants are not covered and route them to B2B1.

B_guard: polynomial bound on distinct successor states
